assertions.description: A 1 kg float in 1000 kg/m^3 water runs to completion without a solver error.
The settled draft matches V_sub = m/rho to within 2%, derived from the declared node properties.
The displaced volume at equilibrium matches m/rho to within 2%.
The heave period matches 2*pi*sqrt(m/k) for the declared waterplane stiffness to within 5%.
The oscillation envelope decays by more than 20% over the run.
